entries.reason: Prove real SQLite domain/event snapshot visibility and second-writer fencing at the watermark boundary.
entries.contract: Domain state and event watermark are captured under one shared journal transaction; uncommitted updates are invisible to independent readers.
entries.invariant: No claimed conversation service or live data access; all state is a temporary private journal.

entries.reason: Compose the app-supervised core with explicit roots and retained finalization barriers; report inert failure kind, fixed refusal reason and involved path through the existing watchdog-protected stop log.
entries.contract: The app supplies socket, token file, profile and data directory; failures are diagnosable without exception text, credentials or synchronous logging before the watchdog.
entries.invariant: Containment and emergency-finalization helper bodies stay byte-identical; profile ownership outlives finalization.

entries.reason: Parse app-owned core launch arguments and delegate authenticated local diagnostics without starting a service.
entries.contract: Missing or invalid launch arguments fail before provisioning; client connects only to the selected local socket.
entries.invariant: No legacy server CLI, remote management API or ambient credentials.

entries.reason: Resolve explicit app-selected token/data roots consistently across composed services.
entries.contract: Profile identifier and both root selections are coherent; partial overrides fail.
entries.invariant: Path resolution never provisions or imports another Odin installation.

entries.reason: Align app/XDG roots; follow directory symlinks under D17, create missing directories 0700 and repair only owned Desktop namespace components, accepting existing permission modes.
entries.contract: Resolve directory paths before traversing real folders with held no-follow descriptors; judge target owners, refuse foreign nonroot owners, allow root without chmod and preserve unrelated ancestor modes. Configured socket directories disable namespace repair.
entries.invariant: No legacy state adoption or chmod of unrelated link targets; substitutions after resolution remain refused.

entries.reason: Recognize app pre-core scaffolding, including interrupted drafts.json.tmp and app-state.json.tmp saves, and anchor the runtime lock to the identity directory.
entries.contract: Fresh identity may coexist only with app scaffolding; one owner holds the identity regardless of socket or data override.
entries.invariant: No engine configuration or secrets are imported; contexts remain OS-owner and incarnation bound without new tool approval policy.

entries.reason: Add private durable command bindings, final receipts and permanent tombstones; inspect existing identities without opening a write transaction.
entries.contract: Served commands reserve before callback and commit receipt/events before response; read and unavailable requests do not reserve IDs or fsync receipts.
entries.invariant: No exactly-once external-effect claim or expired-ID readmission; unknown outcomes are not pruned.

entries.reason: Add durable profile-wide sequence, decimal cursors, bounded retention and reset-aware catchup.
entries.contract: High/floor survive restart and pruning; unknown or expired cursors never imply an empty interval.
entries.invariant: Receipt/event atomicity is supplied by the shared transaction; timestamps are not ordering authority.

entries.reason: Implement bounded v0 minor-2 framing and typed transport envelopes.
entries.contract: Four-byte big-endian length, UTF-8 JSON object, 4 MiB ceiling; unknown fields ignored and method validation stays service-owned.
entries.invariant: No binary frames or payload-derived fault diagnostics.

entries.reason: Load the app token and authenticate OS peers under leaf no-follow guards; follow folder symlinks and repair owned namespace parents without refusing any directory permission mode under D17.
entries.contract: Resolve only the parent folders, then traverse held real-directory descriptors. Token file owner, 0600 mode and constant-time comparison remain mandatory; foreign nonroot target owners refuse, root owners are allowed without chmod and unrelated directory modes remain unchanged.
entries.invariant: Core never creates, repairs or logs the credential; payload identity cannot mint owner authority.

entries.reason: Add authenticated local connections, handshake, ping, safe listener startup and ordered closure.
entries.contract: Protect live sockets; replace only proven stale owned sockets; send subscription result before catchup and live publication.
entries.invariant: Socket cleanup is inode-bound; revoked owner contexts cannot receive or admit work; exceptions are scrubbed.

entries.reason: Supply a bounded authenticated local diagnostic client with no service-start capability.
entries.contract: Verify selected socket/server identity before sending token; status.get is the default diagnostic request.
entries.invariant: No credential arguments, remote listener or automatic mutation retries.

entries.reason: Own parent-pipe or Node-style stream-socket EOF, signal shutdown and admission quiescence without an executor blocked on stdin.
entries.contract: One irreversible shutdown edge; stdin is an app-held FIFO or stream socket, never a regular file or datagram socket; the core never detaches.
entries.invariant: No broad process signaling, daemon resurrection or bypass of retained finalization.

entries.reason: Compose the supervised graph; refuse unavailable methods without receipts and expire known final receipt bodies at startup and periodically.
entries.contract: Only step-1 services are available; status is a read, shutdown receipts/events are durable, unresolved outcomes and permanent identity tombstones survive retention.
entries.invariant: Reuse sealed owner authority and PermissionManager; no execution-service graph, new approvals or fake readiness.

entries.reason: Exercise selected roots, app bootstrap, identity lock, entry containment/finalization and actual supervised core startup below linked config/data/cache/socket folders.
entries.contract: Real temporary profile state plus isolated primitive mocks; no Markdown-wording assertions.
entries.invariant: No live config/data, desktop input or unsafe process test literals.

entries.reason: Prove temporary-profile core handshake, status, journals, restart, lock races and parent EOF using real local processes.
entries.contract: Run only through the PID-namespace runner; no engine jobs or external effects.
entries.invariant: Protocol receipts do not claim external execution; cleanup releases only this test's resources.

entries.reason: Exercise reopen, refusals, conflicts, tombstones, pending crash recovery and storage/commit failures.
entries.contract: Real SQLite transactions and benign subprocess interruption; exact ambiguous outcomes stay unknown.
entries.invariant: No destructive commands or mocked attack inputs.

entries.reason: Exercise durable ordering, retention boundaries, reset-required cursors and transaction rollback.
entries.contract: Real private temporary journals, not artifact-existence tests.
entries.invariant: Pruning cannot reset profile sequence or imply certainty about lost history.

entries.reason: Exercise actual local socket framing/authentication, linked folder target ownership, private leaf no-follow credential handling and delivery order.
entries.contract: Real Unix peers, bounded frames and scrubbed failure paths in isolated temporary profiles.
entries.invariant: No active desktop, live socket/config or destructive inputs.

entries.reason: Update app/protocol XDG namespace expectations and prove directory symlinks are followed while unrelated directory modes are preserved under D17.
entries.contract: Existing owner, persistence and host parity behavior tests remain retained.
entries.invariant: No upstream original test corpus changes.

entries.reason: Replace the Phase-1 unwired root/client expectation with invalid-argument pre-effect refusal, retaining source-identical finalizer checks.
entries.contract: Absent app launch arguments still reject before any operations; deferred unrelated entry points remain gated.
entries.invariant: No weakened containment-byte or guard behavior assertions.

entries.reason: Adapt retired entries to the core/client and isolate HOME/XDG in the module even when pytest is invoked without the launcher.
entries.contract: Prove delegation and invalid launch refusal; retain wheel/removed REST checks without creating profile directories in the real HOME.
entries.invariant: No server entry points, upstream case erasure or active-desktop execution.

entries.reason: Restore configured SSH socket-directory parity: normalize a guard-only absolute path, create missing folders 0700 and use existing folders without chmod or permission-mode refusal.
entries.contract: Relative configured paths including ../sockets remain unchanged for OpenSSH; folder links are resolved by private_directory, existing modes are accepted, new folders are 0700 and real-folder foreign-nonroot-owner guards remain. Default profile socket directories are still created 0700.
entries.invariant: No SSH protocol, foreground-master ownership, lease, cleanup or containment change.

entries.reason: Exercise namespace repair, permission-mode and symlink parity, configured existing/new/relative linked socket paths, default 0700 creation under umask 002, target ownership refusal and post-resolution link substitution refusal.
entries.contract: Behavior tests use temporary roots and inspect real permissions and ownership decisions.
entries.invariant: No chmod of foreign or unrelated ancestors and no live state.

entries.reason: Prove unavailable/read methods cause no durable receipt transactions and automatic retention preserves command identity and unknown outcomes.
entries.contract: Actual isolated core and SQLite behavior, with deterministic scheduled-prune checkpoints.
entries.invariant: No unknown-effect replay, expired-ID readmission or live state.

entries.reason: Fence the exact SSH provisioning import/call adaptation, including guard-only path normalization and disabled configured-directory repair, while keeping all remaining SSH safety bytes identical to upstream.
entries.contract: Only the private_directory import and constructor call are adapted; master, lease, settlement and process containment bytes remain unchanged.
entries.invariant: No blanket byte-equivalence exemption or changed upstream test corpus.

entries.reason: Replace the obsolete data-diagnostic permission-mode refusal expectation with D17 owned-namespace repair and unchanged unrelated ancestor modes.
entries.contract: Real startup diagnostics accept 0755/0775/0777 ancestors, tighten only owned namespace components to 0700 and retain the remaining neutral health/security behavior assertions.
entries.invariant: No changed upstream test corpus, imported state or diagnostic-success execution authority.

entries.reason: Align trust-directory provisioning with D17 directory-symlink acceptance while retaining explicit-profile and absolute-path requirements.
entries.contract: Real trust materialization below a linked folder retains private file modes and exact contents without chmod of the unrelated target folder.
entries.invariant: No host enrollment, trust-policy, lease, token or live-state changes.
